headline: Senate returns Monday to vote on cloture for the Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act after a pro forma Thursday session.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session on Thursday, November 5, adjourning briefly before reconvening. No substantive business was conducted.

onTheFloor.title: Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act
onTheFloor.status: cloture vote scheduled for Monday, November 9 at 5:30 PM

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly on Thursday, November 5, introducing 7 public bills and 2 resolutions before adjourning. Nine committee reports were filed covering veterans affairs, foreign medical school accreditation, nuclear energy policy, and child protection background checks.
